config.env_vars: AUTH_GOOGLE_ID AUTH_GOOGLE_SECRET AUTH_MICROSOFT_ID AUTH_MICROSOFT_SECRET AUTH_APPLE_COMBINED_CLIENT_ID SUPABASE_AUTH_EXTERNAL_APPLE_SECRET

scripts.fake-env: for name in $npm_package_config_env_vars; do echo $name=foo; done
scripts.start: export $(cat .env) && export OPENAI_API_KEY=$(cat ~/.config/openai.token) && supabase start && tsx scripts/update-supabase-env.ts
scripts.types: export $(pnpm --silent fake-env) && supabase gen types typescript --local > src/types.ts
scripts.gen-migration: { pnpm --silent diff-schema-migrations && pnpm --silent gen-view-sec; } | supabase migration new
scripts.gen-view-sec: grep -rhi 'CREATE\( OR REPLACE\)\? \+VIEW ' ./supabase/schemas/ | sed 's/OR REPLACE //' | sed 's/CREATE VIEW \(.*\) WITH (\(.*\))/ALTER VIEW \1 SET (\2);/'
scripts.diff-remote: supabase db diff --linked | supabase migration new init
scripts.lint: pnpm --silent lint:view-security && pnpm --silent lint:pending-migrations && pnpm --silent lint:pending-types
scripts.lint:view-security: grep -ri '\(CREATE\( OR REPLACE\)\?\|REPLACE\) VIEW ' supabase/schemas/ | ( ! grep --invert-match security_invoker )
scripts.lint:pending-migrations: pnpm --silent diff-schema-migrations | (! grep -q .) || (echo '❌ Pending migrations detected. Please apply or remove them.' && exit 1)
scripts.lint:pending-types: export $(pnpm --silent fake-env) && supabase gen types typescript --local | diff src/types.ts - || (echo '❌ Type definitions are out of date. Please run the type generation and commit.' && exit 1)
scripts.test: export $(pnpm --silent fake-env) && pnpm run test:setup && pnpm run test:lint && pnpm run test:run
